summary: Absci Corp filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a registered direct offering of 13,495,277 shares of common stock at $7.41 per share, with $40 million allocated to Eli Lilly. The offering price equals the last sale price. Jefferies, J.P. Morgan, TD Cowen, and Guggenheim Securities are underwriters. This is a capital-raising transaction, not a special situation like a tender offer, going-private, or activist campaign. The filing is a routine equity shelf takedown with no structural changes, no premium, no board recommendation, and no risk-arb angle. Proceeds will bolster the balance sheet.
